message.content: {"caption":"Four-panel chart comparing curated-data size with model performance across training, plus an overall-performance comparison.","description":"The target is a four-panel chart. At left, “Data Comparison” plots curated data size on a logarithmic horizontal axis, with model names as categories: AZR (Ours), Oat-Zero, SimpleRL-Zoo, ORZ, CodeR1, AceCoder, and PRIME-Zero. Its legend maps yellow-orange to Math and blue to Code. A red star marks AZR (Ours) near the left edge of the scale; an orange bar on the PRIME-Zero row is labeled “457k.” No other bars are discernible. The Math Domain and Coding Domain panels plot Performance against Training Steps, with blue curves and pale-blue shaded bands. Math rises sharply from about 0.25, then fluctuates around 0.34–0.36 before a final rise; Coding climbs from about 0.56 to roughly 0.60, then continues a more gradual, fluctuating rise to around 0.61–0.62. The Overall Performance panel plots steps from 0 to 350 and performance from 0.40 to 0.52. A blue line for “Performance During RL” rises quickly at first, then levels off and fluctuates around 0.48; an open blue circle marks the Base model near (0, 0.40), a red dashed horizontal line marks the Prev. SOTA Model at about 0.486, and a blue star marks the AZR Final Model near (350, 0.50), above the dashed line.
